name: object-spread-reads
description: An object spread reads each field of the value it copies and no accessor its class declares, because the runtime copies own enumerable properties and a class's accessors sit on its prototype. A class member is an accessor by its declaration, so a spread through a mapped type over the class, Readonly of it, reads no getter either, and a getter nothing else reads is reported. A spread copies a method an interface declares and calls none, so an interface method nothing calls is reported. An accessor an interface declares is read as a property is, so a spread reads it.
